summary: Checked the Twilio signature fix. Everything passed and no calls were placed. Logs: backend.out.log shows 403s on POST /api/twilio/voice (the last at line 543), then a real Twilio 'POST /api/twilio/dial-status?call_id=__sigcheck HTTP/1.1 200 OK' at line 581. The new warning 'Twilio signature check failed ... must be the account's primary Auth Token' is written to backend.err.log. Backend: new test file test_twilio_signature.py (8 tests) plus the existing test_twilio_live.py (11 tests), 19/19 passing. /twilio/voice signed with RequestValidator(current TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN), using a nonexistent call_id, From=client:x and CallSid=CAtest, returns 200 with application/xml and 'This call could not be placed.' and no <Dial>. A bogus signature returns 403 'Invalid Twilio signature', and a valid signature on tampered params also returns 403. /twilio/dial-status?call_id=nonexistent with a valid signature returns 200 with an empty <Response />; with a bogus signature it returns 403. /twilio/status (admin) shows connected=true and caller_id=+18506050135. /twilio/token returns a JWT for both admin and agent, and 401 without auth. UI at 1920px as admin, with all non-GET /api requests blocked by route guard (none were attempted): no twilio-not-ready-banner, dialer-caller-id-select=+18506050135, dialer-start-btn enabled (not clicked). dialer-dock-hangup-btn is disabled and greyed out (bg rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), so the iteration_2 design note is fixed. The session survives a reload.

issues: The list select cuts off its option text ('Homeowners in Navarre Beach Florida · 249 l…') at 1920px. Consider a wider select or a shorter label.

critical_code_review_comments: verified_form builds the signing URL from settings.base_url. If base_url ever goes stale (domain change or prod deploy) without rerunning setup, every webhook will 403. The warning log now makes this visible; consider also checking the request's host against base_url in the log.
twilio_dial_status runs update_one for any call_id that passes the signature check. That is fine because Twilio signs it, but it does nothing for unknown ids and returns 200 silently.
server.py is still about 787 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Split it into routers.
test_credentials: admin+clerk_test@example.com (admin, role re-asserted in db.users after regenerating tickets), agent+clerk_test@example.com (agent). Regenerated with /root/.venv/bin/python /app/scripts/clerk_test_tokens.py ticket -> /tmp/tokens.json.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Signed webhook tests used TEST_nonexistent_* and 'nonexistent' call ids; db.calls has 0 matching docs. test_twilio_live.py creates a TEST_live_list and deletes it in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Twilio is LIVE. These suites are safe: test_twilio_signature.py and test_twilio_live.py. Do not run test_autodialer_api.py::test_dialer_next_409. In the UI, guard POST requests with page.route and never click dialer-start-btn.
